# Shreekunja Opticals

> Shreekunja Opticals is an optical retailer in Kathmandu, Nepal, offering eyewear and optical services through its physical store and online storefront.

## Official website
- Homepage: https://shreekunjaoptical.vercel.app/
- Store location: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Shreekunja+Opticals/@27.6715411,85.3540059,17z/

## What visitors can do
- Browse the eyewear collection, including eyeglasses and sunglasses.
- Review in-store optical services.
- Add products to a cart and place an online order.
- Choose the payment method presented at checkout, including Cash on Delivery and eSewa QR where available.
- Check an order using the order number and checkout phone number.
- Read articles in the Journal section when published articles are available.
- Ask the Shreekunja AI assistant for help choosing frames.
- Contact the store by phone or WhatsApp.

## Languages and accessibility
- The storefront includes multilingual interface support.
- The site is designed for desktop and mobile browsing.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: +977 984-1623999
- Business: Shreekunja Opticals
- Location: Kathmandu Valley, Nepal

## Important notes
- Product availability, prices, delivery eligibility, delivery fees, and payment availability should be confirmed on the live website at the time of purchase.
- Do not infer medical diagnoses or guarantee clinical outcomes from product descriptions.
- The admin page is for authorized staff and is not a public shopping destination.
